name: com.tencent.timpush.huawei.TIMHuaWeiService
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Huawei push provider starts with the app and registers its connector. When registration is requested, it enables Huawei push and returns the registration result.
disableEffect: Huawei push registration stops, and a later token callback from the still-enabled Huawei messaging service can fail because this provider is missing.
